title: Fleet Governance v1 — VERDICT
description: Turnstone-adjudicated work outcome. Work outcome vocabulary (PASS/FAIL/INDETERMINATE/ESCALATED) is SEPARATE from evidence epistemology (PROVEN/PROPOSED/ASSUMED/FAILED/INDETERMINATE). PASS requires acceptance + authority compliance + evidence sufficiency.

acceptance.description: Per-criterion Turnstone adjudication. MET only from positive PROVEN evidence references; NOT_MET from a FAILED reference; INDETERMINATE when not positively adjudicated. Absence of a FAILED claim never makes a criterion MET. Executor self-assessment is never authoritative.

authority_compliance.description: VIOLATION when receipt actions_taken exceed allowed_actions or touch forbidden_actions.

evidence_sufficiency.description: SUFFICIENT when all BWP evidence requirements are satisfied and no blocking INDETERMINATE claim remains.

evidence_epistemology.description: Claim-level epistemology, kept separate from work_outcome. A receipt may contain many PROVEN claims and still yield FAIL.

hard_constraint_status.description: Overall hard-requirement satisfaction. VIOLATED when a hard constraint (e.g. inference_locality=local_required) contradicts OBSERVED locality; UNVERIFIABLE when the constraint cannot be established from evidence (=> INDETERMINATE outcome); NOT_EVALUATED when escalated.
